title: Rooms for the Meetings
statement:
There are `n` meetings. Meeting `i` occupies a room from time `s_i` up to, but not including, time `e_i`. A meeting may start at the exact moment another one ends in the same room. Find the smallest number of rooms that lets every meeting happen.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `s_i` and `e_i`.

## Output
Print the smallest number of rooms.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 8000`
- `0 <= s_i < e_i <= 10^9`
